{{Quote|That bomb goes off and the whole island's one big crater.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Bex Kolos]]|<ref name="Running" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Separatist War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-backed government, the [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]], and the insurgent [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]], the separatists took down a Republic transport and stole a [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb]] from its hull. [[Havoc Squad]] was assigned to '''retrieve''' the bomb.

==Prelude==
After the ratification of [[Treaty of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]] and the start of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] did everything it could to keep worlds from leaving it. This included rewarding and catering to local corrupt governments, like the [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|Central Authority]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. This was saw as overstepping the line by local political opposants, who founded the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] with popular support.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

As they were trying to find a way to push the Republic out of Ord Mantell, the separatists managed to down a Republic transport carrying a destructive ordnance, a [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb]]. The separatists stole the bomb before the Republic could do anything about it, and hide it somewhere on the island of [[Avilatan]]. The [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] was afraid the bomb could be used on the island, destroying it utterly, along with [[Fort Garnik]], the headquarter of the [[Mantellian Army]], and the center of loyalists efforts on the planet. To retrieve the bomb, they dispatched a veteran unit from the [[Republic Special Forces Division]], [[Havoc Squad]], under the command of [[Harron Tavus]].<ref name="Running" />

==Mission==
However, the elite unit was considered unmanned by high command, and was assigned a new member, a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|sergeant]]. As he was transiting to Ord Mantell to join with his fellow [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], his [[Republic transport shuttle|shuttle]] found itself in the midst of a space battle. Rushing to reach the planet, the ship finally managed to land safely on [[Drelliad village]] spaceport, where [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Bex Kolos]], a member of Havoc Squad, was waiting. Both soldiers left the village in a [[Manka-class armored transport]] heading to Fort Garnik, and Kolos started to brief his younger comrade about the situation. However, he was interrupted as separatists launched an [[Battle in Drelliad village|assault]] on Drelliad village, and managed to immobilized the APC with [[armor-piercing missile]]s. Following Kolos' order, the sergeant jumped in action to neutralize the unexpected threat. Kolos and the sergeant then walked separately to Fort Garnik.<ref name="Running" />
